def transform(grid):
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    bg=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[c]==bg and row[c-1]==row[c+1] and row[c-1]!=bg:
                out[r][c]=2
    return out
